themes_detail.label: Food Safety Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints surged to 7 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.8 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 300% spike (z-score: 6.33)—suggesting either new violations or accelerated reporting of unsafe conditions in Far Rockaway's dining sector.
evidence: 7 food establishment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (300% increase)
Z-score of 6.33 indicates statistically significant anomaly
reporting_angles: Contact DOHMH to identify which establishments triggered complaints and what violations were cited
Interview restaurant owners and health inspectors about recent enforcement activity or emerging issues

themes_detail.label: Building Code Violations Surge
themes_detail.summary: Building/use complaints jumped to 13 THIS WEEK versus 3.6 weekly average—a 259% spike (z-score: 4.85)—potentially signaling illegal occupancies, unauthorized conversions, or structural safety issues in residential or commercial properties.
evidence: 13 building/use complaints THIS WEEK vs. 3.6 weekly average over 8-week baseline (259% increase)
Z-score of 4.85 indicates highly significant deviation
DOB filed 420 building permits in last 90 days (242 alterations), suggesting active construction environment ripe for violations
reporting_angles: FOIL recent DOB violation notices and complaints tied to active alteration projects in the district
Interview DOB enforcement about illicit conversions or unpermitted work in Far Rockaway

themes_detail.label: Water Quality Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Water quality complaints exploded to 4 complaints 3 WEEKS AGO, a 3100% spike from a 0.1 weekly baseline (z-score: 11.72)—the highest z-score in the dataset—indicating a potentially ongoing contamination or supply issue affecting residents.
evidence: 4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.1 weekly average over 8-week baseline (3100% increase, z-score: 11.72)
Highest severity z-score in entire dataset, indicating crisis-level anomaly
Water System complaints also elevated at 238 in 90-day period, and DEP has repeated budget requests for sewer infrastructure development
reporting_angles: Contact DEP to determine if water quality testing detected issues in Far Rockaway 3 weeks ago and current status
Interview residents about discolored, odorous, or contaminated water; investigate if boil notices were issued

themes_detail.label: Street Lighting Failures
themes_detail.summary: Street light condition complaints jumped to 40 LAST WEEK versus 14.0 weekly average—a 186% increase (z-score: 10.2)—creating public safety and visibility risks across the district.
evidence: 40 street light complaints LAST WEEK vs. 14.0 weekly average over 8-week baseline (186% increase)
Z-score of 10.2 indicates severe statistical anomaly
Links to broader street condition concerns (1,078 complaints over 90 days, persistent baseline issue)
reporting_angles: Identify geographic clusters of broken lights via 311 data; photograph dark blocks for visual evidence
Interview NYCHA or DEP about maintenance backlogs or recent infrastructure failures affecting street lighting

themes_detail.label: Dead Tree Outbreak
themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints tripled to 3 THIS WEEK from a 0.8 weekly baseline—a 300% spike (z-score: 3.4)—suggesting disease, storm damage, or deferred Parks maintenance affecting urban canopy.
evidence: 3 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average (300% increase, z-score: 3.4)
Community board has repeated requests for park reconstruction/upgrades, suggesting long-deferred maintenance
Potential signal of broader environmental degradation or recent weather event impact
reporting_angles: Contact Parks Dept. to determine if disease, storm damage, or budget cuts are driving tree deaths
Photograph dead tree locations; assess canopy health across beach neighborhoods
